title: Confessions of a Cam Girl
description: An 18-year-old creates an explicit content page online to raise $10,000 to go to fashion school. Confident that she can keep her side hustle under wraps, her secret unravels and threatens not just her future, but the safety of her family as well.

title: Webcam Cheerleaders
description: After the death of her beloved sister, Maisy transfers to the college where her sister attended to be closer to her grieving mother and father. Unconvinced her sister died by suicide, Maisy uncovers the truth, which may have deadly consequences.

description: Frustrated with the lack of help from police, a woman launches her own investigation and plans the ultimate takedown after nude photos of her daughter are circulated on a porn site.
